cases.description: 2^60 is a double beyond 2^53; the writer puts it in exponent form, so it is not read back as an integer a double cannot hold.
The same value written as JSON parses back to the same double.
The same value as a front-matter field of a Markdown record parses back to the same double.
1e23 is not an integer by form, so it means its nearest double, which the writer writes back in exponent form.
